@graph.description: Discover New Power Muay Thai at Rajadamnern Stadium in Bangkok. Traditional five-round Muay Thai every Wednesday, with tickets available online.

itemListElement.name: New Power Muay Thai: Wednesday at Rajadamnern Stadium

mainEntity.name: What day is New Power Muay Thai?

acceptedAnswer.text: New Power Muay Thai takes place on Wednesday evenings at Rajadamnern Stadium in Bangkok.

mainEntity.name: What time does New Power Muay Thai start?

acceptedAnswer.text: The event normally starts at 18:00, with doors opening at 17:00.

mainEntity.name: How many rounds are New Power Muay Thai fights?

acceptedAnswer.text: New Power uses the traditional five-round Muay Thai format.

mainEntity.name: How many fights are normally on the programme?

acceptedAnswer.text: New Power normally features eight or nine bouts. The confirmed number can vary by event.

mainEntity.name: Is New Power the same as Rajadamnern Knockout?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. New Power uses traditional five-round Muay Thai, while Rajadamnern Knockout uses a shorter three-round format.

mainEntity.name: Is New Power suitable for someone watching Muay Thai for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A first-time visitor does not need to understand every part of Muay Thai scoring. The five-round structure makes it possible to watch the rhythm and tactical contest develop as the fight progresses.
Sarama is the traditional music performed during Muay Thai bouts. It follows the rhythm of the contest and is part of the traditional stadium environment.

mainEntity.name: Can I arrive after the fights have started?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The stadium gates remain open during the event, so guests may enter after the programme has begun.
